architecture.name: Three-layer, two-parallel-head standard A16
architecture.each_head: Independent standard A16: 16D Q/K/V projections, causal scaled dot-product retrieval, its own output projection to width 384, RoPE base 10000.
architecture.head_combination: Sum the two full-width head outputs divided by sqrt(2), then apply the layer residual once.
architecture.feed_forward: One shared-per-layer SwiGLU after attention-head combination, hidden width 3072 (baseline hidden width 1024).
architecture.cache: One cache entry per layer with two independent streams; 64 scalars/token/layer and 192 across all three layers.

baseline_comparison.baseline: standard six-layer RoPE A16; same tokenizer/data hashes, seed, precision, optimizer, context, and update/token schedule
baseline_comparison.interpretation: Validation is close to baseline on one seed. The model also changes depth, parallel attention count per layer, and FFN width, so the result does not isolate head count alone.
